Name: Lost my shirt
Author: K3vinLevin
Description:
The mod basically removes the white underwear shirt. You also have the option to add a tree leaf instead of underwear shorts

The mod remains compatible with any clothes you want to wear, just change the underwear...

You can select the skin tone from 1 to 24 to match your skin in the mod settings, and also change the "Add Leaf" option to true if you want to play with it.







For the bikinis I was inspired by a bikini from the game, as for the name of the mod, the male model and the censor leaf I was inspired by another mod called [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8912]Lost My Pants[/url] by the author [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/TrashRacc1124/about-me]TrashRacc1124[/url], I used a little bit of his code too, many thanks to him for authorizing.
